facts: Spiked dog collars were invented in ancient Greece and were originally designed to protect dogs throats from wolf attacks.
Flyball, a dog sport consisting of relays, hurdles, and ball retrieving, was developed in the late 60s, and the first tournament was held in 1983.
Rin Tin Tin was the first Hollywood dog star.
Dogs have three eyelids to protect their eyes from debris.
The world's smallest dog was a Chihuahua named Miracle Milly, who weighed only 1.1 pounds.
